name: Moby Analytics

shortDescription: Moby Analytics is an AI-driven platform designed specifically for financial auditors to streamline and enhance their audit processes. It automates routine audit tasks, such as document tracking and workflow management, using AI to classify and validate documents in real time. This tool is ideal for audit firms looking to increase efficiency and focus on higher-value activities.
